changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Dialogue Generation' as the paper focuses on instruction following, not dialogue. Consolidated outputs to single clear description. Normalized model names to consistent format.

Normalized model name to standard format. Consolidated methods to single accurate description. No specific criteria were mentioned for the LLM evaluation.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper - all evaluations used automatic metrics and LLM-as-judge.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper focuses on instruction following as an NLG task, uses automatic metrics (win rates), employs GPT-4-Turbo as an LLM judge, and does not conduct human evaluation. The main corrections were removing 'Dialogue Generation' as a task and clarifying the metrics used.
